title: Portrait with Dog and Ric
description: A painted portrait of a woman with curly light brown hair, red lipstick, and turquoise earrings, wearing a dark off-shoulder dress. She is superimposed over a landscape background featuring a large green and yellow dog-like creature on the left, with semi-transparent text elements reading 'RIC' and 'EE' layered across the composition.
prompt: Expressionist oil painting of a woman with curly light brown hair, dramatic eyebrows, red lips and turquoise earrings wearing a dark off-shoulder dress, her face and torso superimposed over a stormy landscape with a large stylized green and yellow dog-like creature walking on the left side, semi-transparent rectangular text overlays reading RIC and EE floating across the composition, visible brushstrokes, moody atmospheric background with trees and hills
